scope: A fresh reader completes the core task from public instructions. Document source builds, licenses, data/limits/privacy/recovery/support and a confirmed vulnerability reporting route without mandatory cloud or paid entitlements (Requirement N34).
source_identity_method: SHA-256 over sorted C34-owned implementation, test, fixture, and documentation paths; each file contributes its path, a NUL separator and its own binary SHA-256. Excludes plans/, docs/agents/SESSION_HANDOFF.json, status-only README/START_HERE/DEFINITION_OF_DONE and docs/evidence/ to avoid recursive self-reference. Historical evidence remains bound to its original source.

environment.npm: 11.17.0 (toolchain lock pins npm 11.9.0; the executing npm reports 11.17.0)

hardware.required_profile: 4 vCPU / 8192 MiB RAM / 20480 MiB free disk

fixtures.provenance: Repository-authored synthetic installation, usage, contribution, and support contract and negative scenarios; contains no real credential, provider state or plaintext secret.

commands.summary: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.
39 web and contract tests passed, including C34 OSS deliverables verification, negative invariants, sentinels, and offline zero-cloud assertions.
All Go engine packages passed; lifecycle, internal auth, vaults, storage, and domain integration tests passed.
39 Playwright tests passed across 7 parallel workers, including reference workflow, 360px viewport, keyboard navigation, and provider outage handling.
Validated 331 JSON files and repository contract invariants.

results.acceptance: A fresh reader completes the core task from public instructions. Document source builds, licenses, data/limits/privacy/recovery/support and a confirmed vulnerability reporting route without mandatory cloud or paid entitlements.

invariants_verified.fresh_reader_workflow: Enforced; USER_GUIDE.md and CLONE_TO_RUN.md provide complete, tested instructions to clone, build, configure, run, and verify KeyHelix locally without missing steps.
invariants_verified.source_builds: Enforced; npm run build:engine, npm run build, and npm run package recipes documented and validated against clean local sources.
invariants_verified.licenses: Enforced; core licensed under Apache-2.0; upstream dependencies inventoried in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; zero unknown or proprietary dependencies.
invariants_verified.data_limits_and_privacy: Enforced; 1 MiB preview limit, 32 depth limit, 20,000 keys limit; strict zero telemetry; no outbound network calls.
invariants_verified.recovery: Enforced; .local-data custody, OpenBao snapshot restore, and forward repair over stale rollback documented.
invariants_verified.vulnerability_disclosure: Enforced; confirmed private reporting route via GitHub Security Advisories and dedicated security email; 48-hour response SLA; public issue disclosure prohibited.
invariants_verified.zero_cloud_entitlement: Enforced; full feature set operates on local loopback without AWS, GCP, Azure, or paid API keys.
invariants_verified.sentinel_inertness: Enforced; script and HTML sentinels stay inert; required actions navigable via keyboard and structured tables.
invariants_verified.provider_ownership: Enforced; OpenBao retains sealed ownership of secret bytes; engine stores metadata digests; memory auto-zeroes on modal dismissal.
